conditions.condition_text: arsenic trioxide exposure before the first relapse is negative
months from initial therapy completion to first relapse is less than 6 months

failure_examples.interpretation: 两个条件的模型数组均失败；首条件MedNLI反驳，第二条件出现数值跨阈值/多值未知，规则最终U。

conditions.condition_text: original pathological T stage is at least 1
original pathological T stage is at most 2
original pathological N stage is 0

failure_examples.interpretation: 围栏、截断、数组失败并存；三个分期条件均未得到程序可用的数值观察，最终U。

conditions.condition_text: preoperative clinical T stage is at least 1
preoperative clinical T stage is at most 3
preoperative clinical N stage is 0
chemotherapy received before breast surgery is negative
positive sentinel lymph node count is at least 1
positive sentinel lymph node count is at most 2
whole breast radiotherapy planned for this patient is positive

failure_examples.interpretation: 术前分期数值观察缺失；未接受的用药条件由MedNLI判F，AND逻辑使最终错误拒绝F。

conditions.condition_text: positive axillary lymph node count is 0
invasive tumor diameter in centimeters is at most 5 cm
closest resection margin in millimeters is at least 1 mm

failure_examples.interpretation: 三条模型输出均因JSON围栏失效；MedNLI分别支持，但数值观察程序均未抽取到可用数值，最终U。

conditions.condition_text: preoperative clinical N stage is at least 1
post-neoadjuvant pathological N stage is 0

failure_examples.interpretation: 两个目标条件均成功输出Met；数值观察缺失且证据关系未知，程序保守输出U；纯模型原本正确。

conditions.condition_text: malignant cells in latest CSF cytology is negative

failure_examples.interpretation: 单条件生成达到2048无EOS而失败；MedNLI给contradiction并解未知为F，造成错误拒绝。

conditions.condition_text: thyroid lobectomy margin involvement is negative
contralateral thyroid lesion on postoperative imaging is negative
suspicious cervical lymph nodes on postoperative imaging is negative

failure_examples.interpretation: 两个Met条件中一条与证据冲突；另一未解析条件由MedNLI判F，最终AND错误拒绝F。

conditions.condition_text: gross positive thyroid lobectomy margin is positive
gross extrathyroidal extension is positive
confirmed cervical nodal thyroid metastasis is positive
confirmed contralateral thyroid carcinoma is positive
vascular invasion is positive

failure_examples.interpretation: 五条件有四条解析失败；仅有的Met也遇支持/反驳冲突，OR结构最终U。
